jobs.description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

As an AppSec Engineer, you will own the security of how Fever builds software, from the first line of a spec to the code running in production. Working closely with development and platform teams, you will run an AI-augmented secure development lifecycle: combining deterministic scanners (SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC) with LLM-based triage so that developers only see findings that are real, deduplicated and prioritised by risk.

You will also protect the software supply chain in a world where developers work with AI coding assistants, MCP servers and third-party packages every day. You will empower engineering teams by building and guiding intelligent security agents, embedding threat modeling and security requirements early in the design process, and making secure development seamless through developer-friendly defaults.

What would you do at Fever?

On your first month in Fever:

• You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning and follow-up meetings with other areas.

• You will have met the departments of Fever.

• You will get familiar with Fever's technological structure and ecosystem (applications, infrastructure, architecture, etc.)

• You will gain an understanding of our security processes, tools and overall security landscape, including the current SAST/SCA findings backlog and malware alert sources.

After 3 months in Fever:

• You will tune our SAST/SCA tooling and add AI-assisted triage to reduce false positives and duplicated findings.

• You will centralise malware and malicious-package alerts (dependencies, IDE extensions, endpoints, repositories) into a single triage and response flow.

• You will improve engineering specification templates to embed security best practices.

• You will assess developer tools, libraries, and AI plugins to establish practical security guardrails.

On your 6th month in Fever:

• You will introduce AI-assisted threat modeling into the design process, combining advanced AI capabilities with human oversight.

• You will strengthen software supply chain security through dependency management and package controls.

• You will build and oversee security agents that streamline vulnerability detection, remediation, and developer support.

• You will own key SSDLC metrics and share security progress and improvements with engineering leadership.

Key responsibilities

• Own and drive the SSDLC strategy across the organization, embedding security throughout the development lifecycle.

• Enhance security scanning and vulnerability management through automation and AI-assisted capabilities.

• Centralize the detection and management of security threats across code, dependencies, and developer tools.

• Strengthen software supply chain security through secure dependency management, trusted builds, and developer tooling controls.

• Run design reviews and AI-assisted threat modeling, and define security requirements for new features.

• Build, deploy and govern security AI agents and the automation around them in CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).

• Educate engineers on secure coding and safe use of AI coding assistants through training, documentation and secure-by-default libraries.

About you

Must have:

• Strong knowledge of secure development workflows and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).

• Hands-on experience operating and tuning SAST/SCA tooling (e.g. Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk) and reducing false positives at scale.

• Experience using LLMs or AI agents in security workflows (triage, code review, threat modeling), and understanding of their limits.

• Solid knowledge of software supply chain security: package registries and proxies, dependency pinning, SBOM, malicious-package detection.

This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the Sydney, Australia area.

We’re looking for a Growth Account Executive to join our ANZ Sales team. Reporting to the Head of APAC, you’ll drive new business for Fullstory in ANZ while maximizing adoption, customer success, and revenue across your installed base of accounts. (At Fullstory, Growth customers are companies with $5 million to $80 million in annual revenue.)

Fullstory moves fast, and the landscape we play in is always changing. We’re looking for someone who thrives on a challenge and works well autonomously.

In a typical day, you might:

•
Own a territory and actively prospect for new business opportunities.

•
Identify decision-makers and key influencers within prospects’ organizations.

•
Partner with other teams (Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Marketing, and Product) to help customers realize value with Fullstory.

•
Drive adoption of Fullstory and grow your existing customer base through expansion (upsell and cross-sell), renewals, and churn mitigation.

•
Proactively collaborate with key partners on pipeline, existing accounts, and new customer onboarding.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

•
3+ years of SaaS sales experience, which may include business development (SDR/BDR) roles.

•
Experience handling inbound leads and initiating cold outreach to prospective customers, including senior executives.

•
Experience working in a quota-driven environment with dynamic sales cycles.

•
A proven track record of exceeding assigned activity metrics.

The base salary for this position is 100,000 AUD, and is part of an OTE (on-target earnings) of 200,000 AUD. Total compensation will vary depending on relevant experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

Fullstory is a leading behavioral data platform transforming how businesses understand and improve their digital experiences. We’re building something special at Fullstory- and we’re looking for teammates who are curious, collaborative, and driven to make an impact. We’re especially excited about the potential of AI to enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and elevate our work. If that resonates, explore our Winning Ways to see the values that guide how we work and grow together.

About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

• SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.

• Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.

• IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners

• Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category

• Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change

• Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

Senior Customer Success Manager – Australia & New Zealand

About the Role

As Senior Customer Success Manager for Australia and New Zealand (ANZ), you’ll own a portfolio of strategic customers across both markets, including utilities, energy companies, regulators and government bodies. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

We're currently looking for an Account Executive based in Denver, Austin, Miami, San Francisco or Raleigh.

This role is unique and different from almost anything else currently available in the market as you will have full ownership and accountability within a defined market at MaintainX. While you will have numerous resources to ensure your success, you will be completely full-cycle: from prospecting, discovery, demo, to signature.

jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
Our Mission and Opportunity

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. Brightwheel is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. We are a three-time Cloud 100 company , backed by top investors including Addition, Bessemer, Emerson Collective, Lowercase Capital, Notable Capital, and Mark Cuban.

Our Team

Our team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. We embody our Leadership Principles in our work and culture. We are a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

Who You Are

You're someone who can walk into a running function and tell, quickly, what's actually working versus what's just familiar — and you act on that distinction instead of leaving it in place out of politeness. You build with AI rather than just directing others to use it: your own workflows for content, scoring, and outbound have already changed shape around agentic tools, and you have a real point of view on where AI search and signal-based marketing are taking the discipline next. You hold a high bar for what “good” looks like, including for a team you inherited rather than hired, and you'd rather have a hard conversation early than let underperformance run quietly.

What You'll Do / Scope of Work

•
Own the demand generation function's pipeline and revenue number, budget, and existing team from day one.

•
Diagnose the current channel mix and team within the first 60–90 days, and make the call on what to keep, retool, or retire.

•
Shift the function's measurement and programs from a legacy MQL/form-fill model toward signal- and intent-based marketing.

•
Launch at least one channel beyond what's already working — GEO/AEO, dark social, community-led growth, or agentic outbound.

•
Embed AI and agentic tooling into core workflows: content production, lead scoring and routing, outbound sequencing, and reporting.

•
Partner with Sales leadership on funnel definitions, SLAs, and conversion quality.

What You've Done

•
Modernized or turned around an existing demand generation function — not only built one from scratch.

•
Personally used AI or agentic tools to rebuild a marketing workflow, with a specific before/after you can describe.

•
Launched a channel outside the standard paid/SEO/social mix in the last two years, win or lose.

•
Carried a pipeline or revenue target and made real budget reallocation calls based on evidence, not instinct alone.

•
Led a team of specialists or directors, including through a leadership transition.

Brightwheel is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Protecting Our Applicants: Please be aware of recruiting scams impersonating Brightwheel. All legitimate communications come from @ mybrightwheel.com addresses, and we never ask for payment or sensitive personal data as part of our hiring process. If you suspect fraudulent contact, reach out to security@mybrightwheel.com . Thank you for helping us keep our applicant community safe.

jobs.title: Director of Sales, Club & Grocery
jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
About Bobbie

Bobbie makes European-style organic infant formula manufactured end-to-end in the U.S., because we believe every parent deserves to feed their baby with confidence, without judgment and without compromise. No mystery ingredients. No shortcuts. Just clean, thoughtfully made formula that parents can trust.

But Bobbie has never been just a formula company. When the 2022 national infant formula shortage left parents across the country unable to feed their babies, we closed our storefront to new customers rather than leave a single existing family without formula. We went to Washington. We got loud. And we opened our Heath, Ohio manufacturing facility to make sure something like that could never happen again.

That's who we are, and that's what you'd be joining.

Bobbie for Change

Our advocacy arm, Bobbie for Change, exists because making great formula isn't enough if the systems around parenthood are still broken. We fight for paid federal parental leave, push for legislation to prevent future formula shortages, advocate for feeding equity, and support families navigating impossible situations, including donating formula to parents impacted by breast and gynecologic cancers through the Bobbie Breasties program.

We're a company that genuinely believes becoming a parent makes you an activist. The people who work here feel that too.

About the Role

Bobbie’s retail business is scaling fast, and Club and Grocery are two of our most important channels with immense upside opportunity. We’re looking for a Director, Club & Grocery to take full ownership of our existing Club and Food/Grocery relationships and to build the account strategy, retailer relationships, and operating rigor that will carry this business through its next phase of growth.

This is a builder’s role. You’ll own the P&L, run point with buyers and merchandising teams, lead annual joint business planning, and be accountable to the day to day performance of your channels. You will directly manage a National Account Manager on Grocery and be responsible for building out the broader team as the business scales. You’ll report directly to our Chief Growth Officer - which means high autonomy, direct executive visibility, and real influence over how Bobbie’s retail sales organization takes shape as it scales.

What You Will Do

• Own the Club & Grocery P&L. Take full accountability for gross and net sales, trade spend, and profitability across Costco and the Food/Grocery channel.

• Run the Club and Grocery relationships. Serve as Bobbie’s primary, full-scope point of contact with buying, merchandising, and replenishment teams - from executive conversations to day-to-day account execution - with complete accountability for the relationship.

• Lead JBP and category strategy. Own annual and in-year Joint Business Planning, category reviews,item/assortment strategy, trade and promotional strategy etc.

• Own forecasting and demand planning. Build and run the forecast cadence for Club and Grocery, partnering closely with our Demand team to build out an accurate forecast and with Supply Chain to protect fill rates and operational excellence.

• Manage trade investment. Develop and own trade spend and promotional plans across Club & Grocery, with full accountability for ROI and reporting.

• Lead channel expansion. Own Bobbie’s strategy for thoughtful expansion and continued growth into Club and Grocery over a multi-year horizon.

• Build and lead a team. Manage and develop a National Account Manager owning day-to-day execution across Grocery.

• Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with Category Management/Shopper Insights, Supply Chain, Finance, and Brand Management to bring one unified account strategy to every retailer conversation.

• Shape retail sales strategy. Represent Club & Grocery in strategy and planning conversations with the Chief Growth Officer, directly informing how Bobbie’s retail sales organization is built.

How We’ll Measure Success

• Costco and Grocery/Food net revenue and share growth

• Forecast accuracy and fill-rate performance

• Trade spend ROI and promotional efficiency

• On-time, successful product launches and shelf transitions

• Retailer relationship health and vendor management

• Team culture and development

jobs.description:
About Fin

Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. We are a Series A-stage company backed by Sequoia, Circle, and other notable investors. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars in seconds - whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability and trust of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products were reinvented today, they would look like Fin.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our growing product team. You will be responsible for guiding products from early ideation through implementation and continuous improvement. This encompasses user research, product definition, operational management, pricing strategy, go-to-market planning, and post-launch iteration.

Stablecoins are transforming the payments landscape, enabling money to move faster, cheaper, and across borders with ease. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in shaping the future of global money movement.

Responsibilities

•
Lead products end-to-end, from user research and concept exploration to development, launch, and ongoing iteration

•
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, operations, compliance, growth) to define product requirements and ensure seamless execution.

•
Drive product shaping, including problem definition, feature scoping, roadmap prioritization, and alignment around key goals

•
Manage day-to-day operational details, including edge-case handling, internal process setup, tooling needs, and ensuring product readiness for launch

•
Track product performance through metrics and qualitative feedback, identifying opportunities for improvement and steering rapid iteration cycles

•
Work with external partners (ramp providers, DeFi solutions, fintech vendors, and more) to deliver integrated, seamless product experiences

Qualifications

•
Proven experience in product management and/or business development, with a track record of taking products from 0→1 or scaling them from early adoption to broader market fit.

•
Experience collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, designers, operators, sales, and strategic partners.

•
Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting product strategy and insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

•
A data-driven mindset with the ability to leverage analytics to inform decisions, diagnose problems, and drive improvements.

•
A strong bias toward action, you’re comfortable moving fast, navigating ambiguity, and getting hands-on to solve problems.

Bonus Points

•
Background in fintech or traditional financial services, with familiarity in areas like payment flows, FX, treasury operations, compliance, etc.

•
An understanding of (or interest in) Web3 ecosystems, including DeFi protocols, custody models, smart contracts, or crypto liquidity.

•
Data analytics experience (SQL, Python)

•
Prior experience at an early-stage startup, showing comfort with ambiguity, rapid iteration, and building processes from scratch

jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

When the world's largest organizations bet on Mural, Govern & Trust is the team that earns that trust at scale. We build the experiences that help enterprises roll out Mural with confidence, keep it secure, and see the impact it has on how their people work. Data sits at the center of it all. Admins are Mural's most demanding data consumers: they need to prove ROI to their leadership, guide adoption across thousands of people, and account for every action. If data products can meet their bar, they'll work for everyone.

Mural has a modern data platform, strong data engineering and analytics teams, and a wealth of data on how teams collaborate. The next step is treating that data as a product in its own right, with a dedicated owner for what it means and how it's used.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Product Manager you'll define the metrics that describe how Mural creates value, and make them the shared foundation for everything built on top. The same definitions will power internal product decisions, the Insights experience Admins use in the product, and the reporting API and MCP server that customers and AI agents query.

This role starts upstream. You'll work from raw product events to decide what each metric should measure, how it's calculated, and what the data needs to look like for customers and internal teams to rely on it. Then you'll turn those metrics into experiences that help organizations understand and grow their use of Mural.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

•
The evolution of data products. Shape how Mural's data products move from reporting on what happened to guiding what happens next. Work across the Govern & Trust portfolio to define how insights become part of how organizations run Mural.

•
The metric layer. Define Mural's shared, cross-product metrics, like activity, collaboration, and adoption. Set the standards that let product teams define and publish their own metrics consistently. Data Engineering builds and runs the layer; you shape what goes in it and how it evolves.

•
Internal product analytics. Be a thought partner to domain PMs as they set their north-star metrics, and make product data easy for them to explore on their own. Work with Business Analytics to keep product-facing and business-facing reporting working together.

•
Customer-facing data products. Own the strategy and roadmap for Insights: in-product reporting and dashboards, exports and APIs, audit logs, and the methodology behind every number customers see.

•
AI and agent access. Package and launch Mural's customer-facing reporting MCP server: which data it exposes, which plans get it, and what guardrails apply. Define how natural-language and agent-driven analysis extends Insights.

•
Instrumentation. R&D teams own emitting events. Your job is to raise the bar on what they emit. Set per-product requirements for granularity and retention, which differ for audit logs, activity data, and product analytics. Partner with Data Engineering on event standards so metrics start from good data.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

•
5+ years of product management experience, including shipping at least one analytics or reporting product used by paying business customers. You defined the metrics behind it, not just the UI.

•
A track record of making messy or conflicting data trustworthy: reconciling competing definitions, writing metric specs engineers could build from, and getting instrumentation changed upstream.

•
Experience building both platform products, where your customers are internal teams or developers, and end-user-facing data products like analytics, reporting, or insights. You understand how the two have to work together.

•
Working knowledge of modern data stacks: event pipelines, warehouses and lakehouses, dbt-style modeling, and semantic layers. You can write SQL and pull data yourself.

•
The ability to get agreement on definitions across teams you don't manage, including PMs, data engineering, analytics, finance, and go-to-market.

•
Experience with enterprise admin or governance products (IAM, security, compliance, audit)

•
Hands-on experience with semantic layer tools (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, LookML)

•
Experience designing APIs, MCP servers, or connectors for analytics

jobs.description:
Position Summary:

Works cross functionally to develop partnership strategies for clinical trials and programs and works closely with our project teams to provide oversight, strategic expertise in the planning, coordination, and delivery of all activities for designated clinical study projects to ensure that project objectives of quality, scope, cost, and time are accomplished.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

• Direct, manage and ensure collaboration within a team Project Directors and Project Managers in the planning, execution and governance of projects/portfolios on a global platform

• Provide leadership and oversight on all clinical programs and in some unique cases, manage activities

• Interact with study sponsors as primary point of escalation beyond project management

• Optimize the profitability of the Project Management organization to meet or exceed budget targets

• Assess and manage resource allocations to ensure that established cost, time, and quality goals are met

• Select, train, develop and manage the performance of talent in project leadership positions (Project Directors and Project Managers)

• Provide technical support and guidance (including scope definition, risk identification, escalation and mitigation, resource planning, goals and deliverables) to assigned project managers

• Experience with Microsoft Office Products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Microsoft Project

• Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer service demeanor

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally including overnight stays

• Executive presence with ability to confidently deliver complex presentations to senior management

• Ability to lead and inspire excellence within a team

• Ability to create an environment where employees have a sense of ownership that will lead to increases in productivity and efficiency

jobs.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the Role:

As a Forward Deployed Product Manager, AI Agent , you will create, deploy and optimize AI Agents that transform our customers’ businesses and delight their customers. This highly cross-functional and customer-facing role blends product thinking, a nose for value, and project leadership with senior customer executives. At the end of the day, you own each AI Agent and the outcomes they drive for our customers, and you take that personally. You are a creative, pragmatic problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, rolls up your sleeves to build, and excels at turning ambiguity into execution.

In this role, you’ll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who will support the build, integrations and optimization to make the AI Agent product successful. You’ll also work closely with product and engineering, providing a tight feedback loop and custom tooling that will shape the future of our platform.

What You’ll Do:

• Own AI Agent outcomes for our customers — defining and delivering on the metrics that move the needle. This includes finding additional automation opportunities that can provide even more value! To do this, you’ll…

• Own the deployment lifecycle for AI Agents — from pre-sale scoping and kickoff to launch and post-go-live optimization

• Design, build, test and iterate on AI agents in partnership with FDEs using Cresta’s internal tools and the latest technologies to deliver the highest customer ROI

• Lead customer relationships and act as the primary point of contact for AI Agent. Help prospects and customers move faster to ensure we can deliver quickly and effectively.

• Facilitate workshops and design sessions with customer stakeholders to align on agent use cases, workflows, and success criteria while gathering feedback to improve the AI agent platform

• Work closely with FDEs to ensure smooth implementation, build new capabilities as needed and provide feedback and improvements to our broader platform

• Improve our playbooks for agent development and customer deployment

What We’re Looking For:

• 5+ years of experience in Technology Consulting, Implementations, Product, or Customer Success roles, ideally working closely with AI or LLM first products

• Hands-on work style – curiosity with a bias for action. You anticipate needs and bottlenecks and deliver with urgency and care.

• Experience leading complex deployments, owning customer relationships (including senior customer stakeholders), and working cross-functionally

• Strong technical understanding, systems thinking and exposure to building Agents (not necessarily conversational, personal projects count!)

• Comfortable working with ambiguity and learning quickly in a dynamic startup environment

• Passion for AI, automation, and shaping the future of customer experience

Bonus Points:

• Background in product management, conversation design or forward deployed engineering roles

• Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment

• Familiarity with customer support and contact center operations

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family

• Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it

• Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child

• Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future

• Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office

• Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced

• In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
About Us

Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh , a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $ 125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

About the Role

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to help lead our engineering team as we scale.

In this role, you'll work closely with engineers on technical challenges while helping the team navigate ambiguity, make thoughtful decisions, and deliver with speed and quality. Rather than directing every solution, you'll facilitate productive technical discussions, build alignment, and create the conditions for our engineers to do their best work.

We're looking for someone who can think strategically, stay close enough to the technical work to understand trade-offs, ask good questions, and help guide technical decisions, while leading through influence rather than authority. You'll help the team balance long-term technical investments with near-term execution, maintain a high bar for engineering quality, and create the clarity and alignment that enables engineers to move quickly without sacrificing thoughtful decision-making.

What You'll Do

•
Lead and grow a high-performing team of engineers by building a culture of trust, ownership, and autonomy where people can do their best work, make decisions, and continue to develop.

•
Partner closely with engineering and go-to-market stakeholders to ensure the team is solving the right problems - not just building the right solutions.

•
Stay engaged with technical decisions, helping the team reason through architecture, trade-offs, and complexity, without needing to make every decision yourself.

•
Improve the process of how we work, identifying bottlenecks, refining processes, and automating away toil.

•
Bring clarity to ambiguous problems by helping the team align on priorities, make thoughtful decisions, and maintain strong execution.

•
Balance long-term technical investments with near-term business needs, ensuring the team delivers sustainable, high-quality outcomes.

•
Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement where engineers are empowered to lead and make decisions.

What You'll Bring

•
Experience leading engineering teams in a fast-moving environment where priorities and solutions are not always clearly defined.

•
Instinct to step toward ambiguous or unowned problems, including the unglamorous seams between teams.

•
Strong technical judgment and the ability to engage deeply in architectural discussions, understand trade-offs, and guide technical decisions.

•
Comfort working in a TypeScript/JavaScript ecosystem is a plus, though we value strong engineering fundamentals over experience with a specific language or framework.

•
Strong product sense: able to talk directly to customers, absorb inputs from many sources, and determine how a product should work.

•
Communication that keeps other teams informed on your team’s goals, needs, and progress, and that provides your team with enough context to make good decisions even if you aren’t in the room.

•
Experience managing in a remote environment, ideally with a globally-distributed team.

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy and how we approach the process at Socket.

Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

•
Market competitive salary bands

•
Meaningful equity program

•
Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

•
Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

•
Paid parental leave

•
Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites

At Socket, we

•
Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

•
Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

•
Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

•
Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

•
Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

•
Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.

jobs.description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is launching payments across the EU through its Swedish payment institution. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards European businesses and keeps them trading, across Ramp's own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We're a small team that runs on frontier AI tooling: our operators build and use their own automations so they can spend their time on judgement, not admin. We're hiring a KYB/AML Analyst in Stockholm to review and onboard business customers of our Swedish entity, work directly with those customers to get them live, and resolve onboarding requirements raised by our partners. You'll join a small Swedish team and help keep onboarding moving every day as we grow.

What You'll Do

•
Carry out first-line (1LoD) KYB reviews of business customers onboarding with Ramp's Swedish payment institution: company verification, beneficial ownership, sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, and risk assessment

•
Decide standard cases end to end, and escalate complex or higher-risk cases with a clear rationale

•
Handle customer communications through onboarding: clear document requests, follow-ups and status updates

•
Resolve onboarding requirements from our card-issuing and payments partners for EU customers

•
Document decisions to a standard that holds up to second-line and regulatory review

•
Keep Swedish casework moving when teammates are on leave or handling incidents

•
Spend part of your time improving how we work: playbooks, templates and AI-assisted workflows

What You Need

2–4 years of KYB / AML / onboarding experience at a fintech, payment institution, EMI or bank

Fluent English, written and verbal

Swedish (strongly preferred)

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Diep N, VP, Finance at Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Global Controller to take the close, the books, and our control environment and make them theirs.

We're a global, remote-first, private company built on subscription and usage-based revenue, and as we grow we need a controller who can lead the team already in place and sharpen the fundamentals. You'll lead a team of ~7, growing, across revenue accounting, close, AP/AR, payroll, and treasury, and partner closely with me and, given our CFO's broad remit, with stakeholders across Sales, Legal, IT, HR, and Engineering.

What you'll do

• Lead monthly and quarterly close, GL, AP/AR, payroll, and account reconciliations, delivering accurate, timely US GAAP financials. Close currently runs ~10 business days; get us to 6-8 days within your first 12 months, with fewer post-close adjustments and aged reconciliations.

• Own revenue accounting and serve as our technical accounting authority on subscription and usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606), including the ARR-to-GAAP bridge: reconciling ARR, billings, deferred revenue, contract assets, and usage true-ups to reported revenue, and explaining the delta to leadership and the board in plain terms.

• Author technical accounting position memos on contract modifications, SSP allocation, variable consideration, and capitalized contract costs, the work that makes "technical accounting authority" real.

• Own equity compensation accounting (ASC 718): grant accuracy, 409A timing, expense, modifications, and cap-table integrity, in partnership with stock plan administration.

• Manage and grow a team of ~7, with room to scale, building trust quickly and developing the leads beneath you.

• Build a control framework suited to a global, remote-first, private company with subscription and usage-based revenue, keeping the books audit-ready.

• Own our accounting systems roadmap and drive automation across close and reporting.

• Own select treasury operations, including cash management and banking relationships, and partner on FX exposure monitoring given our multi-currency footprint.

• Run our external audit relationship and coordinate with external tax partners on compliance, provisions, and filings.

• Manage the realities of a distributed, remote-first global team: statutory accounting coordination, payroll and contractor controls, entity reporting, and working with Legal, HR, and Tax on international compliance.

What we're looking for

• 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including leading a team through managers or leads.

• A Big 4 (or equivalent top-tier public accounting) foundation.

• Deep US GAAP mastery, particular strength in subscription and usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606).

• A concrete, personally-owned automation or AI deployment in accounting with a measurable result, eliminating a manual reconciliation, reducing close time, or lowering error rate, that you can speak to in detail.

• Experience scaling an accounting function that was already running, not building one from zero.

• A proven track record with external audits and keeping books audit-ready.

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with credibility partnering with senior, cross-functional stakeholders.

• Nice to have: internal controls or SOX-readiness experience; remote-first/globally distributed company experience; M&A or deal accounting exposure; CPA license, active or inactive.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role ranges from $250k to $280k USD (or equivalent in local currency), structured by geographic zone and depending on experience. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

jobs.title: Staff Design Engineer - Americas
jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
Hi 👋🏾 I’m Abhik , Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

•
Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

•
Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

•
Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

•
You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

•
This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’ve grown (in fact, we’ve doubled down).

•
You get to shape the UI and UX of a powerful and complex product. Our users need software that helps them move quickly while adapting to their unique workflows and preferences. As a result, our UI isn’t a simple chatbox, but it can’t rely on a sea of knobs and dials either. It needs to feel approachable to someone using it for the first time while offering increasingly powerful ways to customize and automate their work.

Why You Shouldn’t Apply

Design Engineers come in many flavors, not all of which fit our model. Here are some reasons you might not enjoy the role:

•
You only want to work on design systems . While improving our design system is one of many responsibilities, you won’t be able to work on it exclusively.

•
You like to do extensive research and user testing before implementation. The beauty of being part-Engineer is that you can build conviction by shipping to a subset of users (including our own team) and gathering feedback!

•
You want everything to be perfect before it gets into a user’s hands. One of the drivers of our success is that we ship fast . While we appreciate the strive for perfection, we also realize it doesn’t need to be achieved all at once; instead, we iterate over time, often letting user feedback and business needs drive prioritization.

•
You don’t have excellent taste and execution in visual design. Design Engineers set the bar for visual design in our app and continually improve it, pushing its boundaries with each new feature or redesign.

•
You need company-driven process and structure to get your projects across the finish line. Sprint planning and well-defined project management processes are things you need or look to others to lead. You’d rather focus on the design and technical details.

•
You only want to do exciting work. We’re building a team of kind, collaborative folks. Customer issues and investigations are distributed across the team, including our high-level ICs.

In 1933, Harry Beck introduced a radically different map of the London Underground. Rather than faithfully depicting the geography of London, he simplified the sprawling transit network into clean lines, clear connections, and a system that anyone could navigate. Distances were distorted, angles were standardized, and unnecessary details disappeared. The result was something far more useful than a geographically accurate map: a way for millions of people to understand a complex system and confidently find their way through it.

Beck understood something fundamental. The best way to explain something complicated isn't to show people everything. It's to understand what matters to them and make that unmistakably clear.

Open call for Founders / Founding Teams (Product Management / Engineering roles)

In 1973 at Xerox PARC, Bob Metcalfe sketched a way for many computers to share a single wire — borrowing the throughput math from his study of Hawaii's ALOHAnet — and he and David Boggs built it and measured it until it held. Behind Ethernet was a two-person team that turned a contested idea into the measured standard now carrying almost all the world's wired traffic.

At Mercury, we’re looking to accelerate several of our AI products that our customers love like Command, CLI, and MCP. We’re building for ambitious people of all kinds, and are a company made of founders and small technical teams trying to change the world - as part of that, we’re taking open applications for founders or small technical teams (Eng+) that want to work together on building the AI products of the future. This isn't a fixed role. We expect the nature of work is changing, and small teams of people paired with AI product surface and autonomy to build can create 10x outcomes. Apply as a small team or as an individual

Here are some things you’ll do on the job:

• Find the problem. Work close enough to customers that you spot what matters before anyone assigns it to you — then decide it's worth building.

• Build and automate the workflow end to end using Command, CLI, MCP, and the rest of our AI stack.

• Ship to customers fast — quick understanding, tight iteration, deploy.

• Measure the impact honestly, then do the next one. Kill what didn't move; double down on what did.

• Run as an autonomous team — pick the target, ship the thing, own the outcome.

You should:

• Have shipped something real - a product, a tool, a company, or an open-source project people actually use.

• Be dangerous across the stack: PMs who can prototype, engineers with product taste.

• Have strong opinions about AI products and the judgment to recognize fast when one of them is wrong.

• Hands experience building AI products with AI, and knowledge about RAG, evals, agent harnesses a plus

• Move fast and measure. Expect most experiments to fail and treat that as the price of finding the ones that don't.

• Care about craft where it's impactful and resist polishing what isn't.

• Communicate clearly and own outcomes - we want real business impact, customer time/pain saved, and a path to scaling what works

Learn more about what we're building:

• Mercury Command — Complete financial work end-to-end with AI. Tell Mercury what to do in natural language; it stages the action and executes with your approval.

• Mercury MCP & CLI — Give your AI agents direct access to verified financial data, or work with your Mercury account straight from the terminal.

Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our team. The Senior AI Engineer will be a pivotal technical leader, responsible for designing, building, and scaling the autonomous AI agents that form the core of our behavioral health platform. This role requires deep expertise in developing complex, multi-agent systems, leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for reasoning, planning, and goal setting, and applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) techniques to model and influence human behavior safely and ethically. You will drive the entire lifecycle of our agents—from developing cognitive architectures and interaction models to ensuring their robust, high-availability deployment and continuous learning in a production environment. Given the sensitivity of behavioral health, this role demands an exceptional focus on safety, ethical autonomy, transparency, and data privacy. The ideal candidate is a seasoned engineer who can bridge the gap between theoretical AI (specifically RL and planning) and real-world, scalable, and impactful user interactions. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

Talkspace HQ is in NYC; this position is based in Eastern Standard Time hours.

What You’ll Do

• Autonomous System Architecture: Design and implement the technical architecture for Tee's core AI agents, including the development of planning modules, memory/retrieval systems, goal-setting algorithms, and tool-use orchestration.

• Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Behavior: Apply advanced RL, Inverse RL, or related control theory methods to develop agents capable of adaptive, long-term intervention strategies that maximize positive user outcomes while minimizing risk (e.g., optimizing interaction sequencing, timing, and content).

• LLM Integration and Fine-tuning: Select, fine-tune, and deploy foundation models (LLMs) to power agent reasoning, natural language understanding, and empathetic, context-aware communication with users.

• Complex Interaction Modeling: Develop models for human-agent interaction (HAI), incorporating principles from cognitive science and behavioral economics to ensure agents are effective, trustworthy, and aligned with therapeutic protocols.

• Simulated Environments: Construct robust simulation environments for pre-training and testing agent policies, ensuring system stability and safety across a wide range of psychological and behavioral scenarios.

• Performance and Resilience: Optimize the deployment environment to manage the computational demands of multi-agent orchestration, ensuring low-latency decision-making and high system resilience.

• Technical Strategy: Lead the evaluation and adoption of new agentic frameworks, reasoning technologies, and system design patterns that position Tee as a leader in autonomous behavioral health technology.

• Agent Evaluation & Observability: Design and implement comprehensive evaluation pipelines for multi-agent orchestration—including visualisations, trace-level analysis of LLM calls and tool invocations, offline evaluation against golden datasets, real-time production monitoring for behavioral drift and outcome correlation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop annotation workflows. Establish metrics frameworks to assess reasoning quality, task completion, safety compliance, and task alignment across the full agent lifecycle.

jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: All Jobs
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We're hiring a Nurse Practitioner to serve as the primary clinical point of contact for patients navigating their remote care journey.

In this role, you will lead clinical decision-making with a strong emphasis on guideline-directed medical therapy for heart failure, as well as adherence to evidence-based guidelines for type 2 diabetes and hypertension, including proactive and asynchronous medication titration based on patient vitals, symptoms, and trends. You will oversee patients, manage clinical escalations, and collaborate closely with the patient’s physician or provider to optimize treatment plans, adjust medications, and determine the appropriate level of care. This role requires a high level of clinical autonomy, strong judgment, and close collaboration with Registered Nurses and Patient Success teams to deliver timely, patient-centered, and scalable remote care.

Although this position is fully remote, it is a highly collaborative, fast-paced clinical role with clear expectations for productivity, responsiveness, and quality.

Licensure Requirements

Required: Active Compact Multi-State RN license.

Required: Active NP licensure in MS.

Licenses must be active and in good standing at time of hire.

Schedule Requirements

This role is fully remote. Monday through Friday schedule with a core shift schedule of 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Central Time.

What You'll Do

• Manage a panel of patients receiving remote care, making timely clinical decisions based on evidence-based guidelines for heart failure, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes.

• Deliver high-quality, evidence-based care by following established clinical protocols and workflows while applying sound clinical judgment to individual patient needs.

• Initiate and titrate guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) while collaborating closely with physicians, RNs, and care teams to optimize outcomes.

• Respond promptly to clinical escalations generated through remote patient monitoring, including abnormal vitals, symptoms, and laboratory results.

• Provide both synchronous and asynchronous patient care, including reviewing patient-generated health data, responding to remote patient monitoring alerts, communicating through secure messaging, and conducting scheduled virtual visits when appropriate.

• Deliver safe, efficient, high-quality care while consistently meeting established productivity and documentation expectations.

• Adapt quickly to evolving workflows, software enhancements, and operational processes as we continuously improve our care model.

• Use multiple technology platforms confidently and provide feedback that helps improve our clinical operations and technology.

• Collaborate across clinical and operational teams to identify opportunities to improve patient care, efficiency, and scalability.

• Help shape the future of a rapidly growing digital health organization where every team member contributes to building better processes—not simply following established ones.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

Who You Are

Successful Nurse Practitioners at Cadence:

• Balance exceptional patient care with strong operational efficiency.

• Are comfortable working in an environment where workflows evolve rapidly as we grow.

• Embrace change and view new technology and processes as opportunities rather than obstacles.

• Consistently meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality clinical decision making.

• Communicate proactively when they encounter barriers or identify opportunities for improvement.

• Take ownership of problems and work collaboratively to solve them.

What You Need

• Active Compact Multi-State RN license.

• Active NP licensure in MS.

• Ability to consistently work Central time hours, including later weekday coverage as needed

• 5+ years experience treating patients with chronic diseases (CHF, Hypertension, T2D) either in an outpatient or inpatient setting at a high-performing medical center.

• 3+ years of cardiology experience with a focus

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions

Coinbase's Enterprise Risk Management team helps the company identify, understand, and manage risks that could affect our strategy, operations, and customers. As an Enterprise Risk Management Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of risk, data, and strategy, supporting core ERM activities while using data and technology to make them more insightful and scalable. You'll analyze risk information, identify emerging risk patterns and signals, improve GRC data quality, support risk tooling and automation, and translate analysis into clear insights that help leaders make better risk-informed decisions.

What you'll do:

• Analyze large, complex, and sometimes unstructured datasets to identify trends, anomalies, correlations, concentrations, and emerging enterprise risk signals.

• Build repeatable analytical methodologies, dashboards, metrics, and visualizations that improve how Coinbase understands and monitors enterprise risk.

• Connect information across risk assessments, incidents, KRIs, audit findings, regulatory developments, business performance, and external signals to develop an integrated view of risk.

• Investigate changes in risk indicators, challenge assumptions, identify underlying drivers, and distinguish meaningful signals from noise.

• Automate recurring analysis, data preparation, and reporting using SQL, Python, AI, and other available technologies.

• Partner across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Security, Operations, Strategy, and regional teams to understand evolving risks and translate complex analytical findings into concise, executive-ready narratives and recommendations.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 1-4 years of experience in risk analytics, data analytics, business intelligence, financial analysis, or a related analytics discipline, with demonstrated ability to extract, clean, join, and analyze complex datasets.

• Proficiency in SQL and working experience with Python or comparable analytical tools for data manipulation and analysis.

• Demonstrated ability to move from an ambiguous business question to a structured analytical approach and actionable conclusion, including independently investigating unexpected results.

• Ability to translate analytical findings into clear risk insights for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, connecting how findings relate to enterprise-wide risk, opportunities, or decisions.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

About Customer.io

Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, I’m Matt Lane, Sr. Manager of Account Management at Customer.io , and I’m hiring a Sr. Account Manager to join our EMEA team. This is a sales role. You’ll own a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise customers and be accountable for generating expansion pipeline, closing new revenue, and securing renewals.

You’ll build on existing customer relationships and prospect beyond them. That means cold calling people who haven’t worked with us, identifying new buying teams, and winning business with additional brands within the same parent company. You’ll lead discovery, build relationships with multiple stakeholders, and own each deal from the first conversation through negotiation and close.

We’re looking for someone with a track record in B2B sales who can walk us through an expansion deal they sourced and closed. You should be comfortable generating your own pipeline, multi-threading across complex accounts, and using a sales methodology such as MEDDICC to qualify opportunities and move deals forward.

This role is open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland only.

What we value

• Commercial ownership — you treat your book of business like it's yours, because it is

• Forecasting discipline and data-driven decision-making, not gut feel

• Multi-threaded relationships — you build trust across the org, not just with one champion

• Expansion through value, not feature gates or mechanical levers

• Close partnership with Customer Success — you see CS as a collaborator, not a handoff

What you'll do

• Own the full commercial strategy for a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts — renewals, expansion, and churn mitigation

• Drive growth by helping customers adopt Customer.io more strategically, identifying new use cases and articulating ROI clearly

• Forecast renewal and expansion pipeline accurately with a clear, repeatable methodology

• Build multi-threaded relationships from day-to-day operators to Directors and VPs, becoming a trusted commercial advisor

• Partner closely with Customer Success on account health and with Sales on expansion deals

• Engage Legal and Finance on complex renewals and collaborate cross-functionally to move deals forward

What we're looking for

• 3+ years in Sr. Account Management, Sales, or a related SaaS commercial role with direct ownership of a revenue number (5+ years preferred)

• Experience managing $5m ARR, predominantly in the MM space

• Proven ability to grow customer spend outside of overages or true-ups — genuine expansion through adoption and value articulation

• A forecasting methodology you can walk through clearly — it doesn't need to be a named framework, just logic you own

• Comfortable pulling usage data, tracking health scores, and building your own dashboards

• Strong communicator — clear and persuasive with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Based in the UK or Ireland

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $142,900 - $171,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in your local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role is a 70/30 OTE split. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• 30-minute video call with a Recruiter

• 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager

• Take-Home Assignment

• 1-hour Assignment Review Call with the team

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-sr-account-manager-emea

Headquarters: Remote (U.S.)

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is hiring a Director of User Experience Research to lead our research team, drive a user-centered understanding of Players (the people who use Discord), and turn that understanding into a better product. You'll own the research strategy for Discord, build and lead a team of researchers, and make sure a deep, evidence-based understanding of user needs shapes what we build before decisions are made.

You'll uncover and forecast the problems our users face and the opportunities that will add the most value to Discord. You'll deepen our understanding of every user cohort, from longtime gamers to new communities, creators, moderators, and teens. And you'll make sure what we ship results in user value for them. As Discord brings more AI-powered experiences to users, you'll ensure they're grounded in real needs and held to a clear, user-centered quality bar. You'll also modernize how research gets done, using AI to increase our speed and reach without losing rigor.

You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Safety. This person will report to the VP of Product Design and Insights.

What You'll Be Doing

• Set the research vision and make research a strategic partner. Own the research roadmap across Discord, balancing foundational, generative, and evaluative work and prioritizing by user impact, business impact, and risk. Deliver clear, compelling readouts that shape prioritization and go/no-go calls, and measure research's impact on product outcomes.

• Uncover opportunities and build a shared understanding of our users. Lead foundational and generative research that surfaces unmet needs, pain points, and emerging behaviors, and use segmentation, longitudinal, and international research to understand how different user cohorts use Discord and where their needs differ, so teams design for real people instead of assumptions.

• Own usability and concept validation. Establish a consistent program for testing concepts, prototypes, and live experiences, so teams learn early whether ideas are desirable, usable, and valuable before investing heavily.

• Bring a mixed-methods lens to every major decision. Partner with Data Science to combine qualitative insight with quantitative evidence (surveys, behavioral data, experimentation) that explains both what users do and why. Define and track experience-health measures such as satisfaction, ease, and trust over time.

• Define user-centered quality for AI-powered experiences. Work with Product, Engineering, and ML partners to set quality dimensions, rubrics, and human evaluation programs that complement automated and model-based evaluation, so AI features solve real Player problems and earn user trust.

• Build and scale the practice. Hire and develop researchers and research leads, and create the career paths, rituals, and research operations they need. Equip PMs and designers to run lightweight research with the right guardrails.

• Modernize research with care and integrity. Adopt and govern AI-assisted tools for recruiting, moderation, synthesis, and insight management that help the team move faster and reach more users. Set the standard for ethical research, including rigor, bias, privacy, consent, and research with teens and vulnerable communities, in partnership with Legal, Privacy, and Safety.

What you should have

• 12+ years of experience in UX research or a closely related field (such as HCI, Psychology, or Cognitive Science), including 6+ years leading researchers and research leads

• Deep expertise across generative and evaluative methods, both qualitative and quantitative, with the judgment to turn ambiguous questions into a clear set of risks and design right-sized research for fast-moving product contexts

• A track record of research that uncovered new opportunities and changed product direction, not only validated existing plans, including usability and concept-testing programs that teams relied on

• Experience understanding and segmenting diverse user populations, ideally in consumer social, community, communication, or multi-sided platforms

• Experience researching AI or LLM-powered products, including human evaluation, rubric design, and inter-rater reliability, with a clear view of where automated evaluation helps and where it falls short

• Fluency with AI-enabled research and data tools, and sound judgment about when they strengthen research and when they weaken it

• A history of earning buy-in from executives and cross-functional partners by telling the user story and making the "so what" impossible to ignore

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

The Demand Generation team brings Tailscale to the people who need it, wherever they already spend their time. For many technical folks, that's a favorite YouTube channel, podcast, newsletter, or stream. As our Demand Gen Coordinator, you'll help us show up in those places in a way that feels genuine and earns trust.

You'll find creators and outlets who share our values, build real relationships with them, and guide partnerships from first hello to final deliverable. Along the way, you'll write briefs, review content, keep projects on track, and help us learn what actually works. This role is a great fit for someone early in their career who loves both technology and the people who make content about it, and who wants room to grow.

Key Responsibilities

Creator Research & Discovery

• Research and identify creators across YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, streaming, and social media who cover self-hosting, networking, security, and developer tools.

• Evaluate creators on audience fit, content quality, technical accuracy, values alignment, and brand safety.

• Build and maintain a creator pipeline that tracks prospects, past partners, and performance history.

Outreach & Relationship Management

• Own outreach to new creators and act as their day-to-day point of contact.

• Maintain strong, long-term relationships across partnerships that often span one to two quarters with multiple deliverables.

• Partner with your manager on proposals, negotiations, and budget by preparing recommendations on rates, deliverables, and timelines.

Contracts & Partnership Operations

• Navigate internal processes for contracts, legal review, vendor setup, and payments in partnership with Legal and Finance.

• Track deliverables, deadlines, payments, and usage rights across all active partnerships.

• Keep internal stakeholders informed on partnership status, upcoming content, and blockers.

Briefs, Content Review & Facilitation

• Write clear creative briefs that turn product launches, features, and key messages into guidance creators can run with.

• Review content drafts for technical accuracy, messaging, brand guidelines, and disclosure requirements.

• Facilitate feedback between creators and internal teams, including Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Engineering, and Legal, when needed.

• QA tracking links, UTMs, and promo codes before content goes live.

Performance & Reporting

• Track and report on partnership performance, including reach, engagement, signups, and pipeline influence.

• Share learnings and recommend where to invest next based on what's working.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work with Community Programs, Developer Relations, Social, and Lifecycle Marketing to amplify creator content and connect creators with launches, events, and campaigns.

As a Senior / Staff Backend Engineer on this team, you won’t just close tickets - you’ll architect core reliability solutions that shape how Wrike scales, performs, and recovers from failure.

• Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts, including high availability, CAP theorem, and fault tolerance.

• Deep experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and key–value / non-relational storages (Redis).

The team operates as an internal “reliability task force,” partnering closely with product and platform engineering teams across the company. You’ll collaborate with other senior engineers who value autonomy, deep technical discussions, and rigorous engineering practices. The culture is ownership-driven: you are trusted to manage your time, make architectural decisions, and drive initiatives to completion.

That's your seat.

Every month they publish their own passive income in public. Most money teachers won't show you their numbers. Ours put theirs out every month.
What you'll actually do

You'll call warm leads. No bought lists and no cold calling.

• About 200 new leads come in every month from our webinars and referrals.

• Behind them are 30,000 people who know our name and haven't heard from us in a while. Some raised a hand this morning and some a year ago.

The math (check it yourself)

• $2,000 monthly base

• $50 to $100 for every appointment that shows

• About $300 for every sale that closes from your bookings

20 closes a month is $6,000 in commission. Add the $2,000 base and you're at $8,000 before appointment pay. That's what this seat is built to produce.
You won't get there in your first month. The early stretch is leaner while you learn the system and build your pipeline. Setters who win treat that stretch as an investment. Setters who wash out treat it as a paycheck.
Where this goes: We're filling closing seats too. They go to whoever earns them, and the fastest way to earn one is from this chair.
